prompt: A hydrocarbon with molecular formula C7H8 shows the ¹H NMR spectrum below (δ 2.3 s, 3H; δ 7.1 m, 5H). Which compound is it?

options.label: p-xylene (only 2 methyls would show, but singlet aromatic)

explanation: Methyl singlet at 2.3 (benzylic CH3 of toluene) + 5 aromatic H in the 7.0-7.3 range. Note the small integration ratio and the absence of OH/C=O signals rules out phenol and the carbonyl-containing options. Benzene has no CH3; p-xylene would show 2:4 ratio instead of 3:5.
